bellman.title: 🛎️ Bellman Department - Guest Service Points
bellman.description: Points are awarded to bellmen when receiving and bidding farewell to guests, and completing luggage transfer requests. Fast completion grants additional rewards.
bellman.tip: 💡 The faster the response, the more points earned

housekeeping.title: 🧹 Housekeeping Department - Cleaning Points
housekeeping.description: Housekeeping staff earn points when starting cleaning, completing rooms, and passing inspection. The specified times are the maximum for completion.
housekeeping.tip: ⚡ Completion before the specified time = bonus points | Delay = point deduction

maintenance.title: 🔧 Maintenance Department - Repair Points
maintenance.description: Maintenance technicians receive points when completing repair requests. Speed in solving problems is important for guest comfort.
maintenance.tip: 🔧 Fast maintenance means happy guests and more points

coffeeShop.title: ☕ Coffee Shop Department - Order Points
coffeeShop.description: Points are calculated based on the speed of preparing and delivering beverage and snack orders to rooms.
coffeeShop.tip: ☕ Fast delivery = bonus points | Delay = deduction

procurement.title: 📦 Procurement Department - Supply Points
procurement.description: Procurement staff are evaluated based on the speed of providing requirements for each department. Time targets vary by requesting department.
procurement.tip: 📦 Each department has a different procurement target time

reception.title: 🏨 Reception Department - Service Points
reception.description: Reception staff receive points when creating requests and confirming them quickly. Delay in confirmation leads to point deduction.
reception.tip: ⏱️ Confirmation speed is important - severe delay means double deduction

ratings.title: ⭐ Ratings System - Guest Satisfaction Points
ratings.description: Points are awarded based on guest rating of the service provided. Excellent rating means more points, poor means deduction.
ratings.tip: 🎯 Guest satisfaction is the most important criterion

financial.title: 💰 Financial Values - Redemption System
financial.description: Sets the value of each point in SAR and the minimum required to request reward redemption. Redemption requests are reviewed by management.
financial.tip: 💵 Employee can request point redemption when reaching the minimum

challenges.title: Commitment Rewards Settings
challenges.description: Customize the number of points awarded to employees when they achieve commitment streaks.
challenges.smartRewardsDescription: These values are automatically applied to all employees when they record daily attendance. Changing these values does not affect previously earned points, but applies only to upcoming rewards to ensure fairness in financial records.
